coordinated_protocol: Coordinator resumes the latest append-only checkpoint, verifies current baseline/candidate SHAs and existing PR delivery, and selects one decision bottleneck. Keep one active experiment; a 45-minute tick need not start new work.

Reuse manifest-discovered existing analytical roles. Assign bounded read-only questions to at most two complementary specialists plus one independent challenger within available concurrency. Each gets frozen inputs, owned output path, allowed sources, budget and a concrete completion criterion. Avoid paid dispatch and production mutation.

Source/meaning work reuses screener-event-statement, screener-world-change, screener-novelty and relevant evidence tools; exposure/ranking work reuses screener-beneficiary-map, screener-market-implied and candidate-surfacing only after its routing prerequisites; outcome work reuses screener-checkpoint-validator and the existing deterministic calibrator/rescorer contracts.

Independent challenge reuses screener-thesis-red-team and integrity rules. It checks source authenticity, qualifier retention, point-in-time availability, numerical basis, counterevidence, likely false positives and missed opportunities; it may cap/reject but never raises conviction or rewrites a locked record.

Coordinator reads each complete report, records every material finding as accepted, rejected with evidence, or blocked, and resolves contradictory facts by source hierarchy rather than majority vote. One implementation owner makes one coherent candidate only after preregistration.

Preregister sample IDs, exact forecast horizons, matching variables, primary metric, acceptance rule, cost budget and critical guardrails before seeing outcome labels. Baseline and candidate use identical frozen inputs, lags, universe, policy and costs; preserve all variants including failed ones.

Immediate correctness fixes use deterministic regressions and admissible positive controls. Historical LLM replays remain development evidence once viewed. Predictive claims need untouched historical out-of-sample or prospective shadow outcomes with all eligible selected/rejected/abstained cases registered.

Admit, reject, or hold in shadow only on the preregistered rule. Preserve small-N refusals and human/spending gates. Deliver accepted code through the protected PR workflow and standing authorized merge path; inspect automatic deployment read-only where relevant. Append evidence, disposition, delivery and one next action.

If two consecutive ticks add no evidence to one obstacle, narrow or change method, or record that dependency blocked and continue independent work. Do not multiply active candidates while waiting for review or outcome labels.

cautions: The existing selected-minus-discarded edge score is explicitly a proxy, not realized investment return.

The feedback-tuning command is recommend-only and prohibits writing live rank weights automatically; preserve that human gate.
